## Houston 1.0.5

### What's new

- **Your AI Employee tells you what it's about to do.** Before it starts working with your apps or files, it writes one short line, so you see a reply start within seconds instead of waiting while it works.
- **Claude Haiku 5.5 is available** in the model picker.
- **"Every N minutes" routines run exactly N minutes apart.** A routine set to every 16 minutes now runs every 16 minutes all day, instead of starting over at the top of each hour.

### Fixes and polish

- Messages to AI Employees with many files are accepted faster.
- Routines in the cloud keep what they remember between runs, so they no longer repeat work they already did.
- A routine deleted while it was running no longer stays "running" forever.
- The notice that your session is ending now spans the whole window.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
